name: Two domain labels in one query resolve without ambiguity
note:
Regression case for a MODEL-WIDE bug. Every domain cube in reference_domains.yml defined its label as unqualified COALESCE(name, name_base). That works for ONE domain at a time and fails the moment a query selects labels from TWO, because every domain subquery exposes the same two column names:

    Error: column reference "name" is ambiguous

Orderfacts joins four of these cubes, so asking for a delivery rule and an invoice rule together - an ordinary dashboard question - was enough to break it. All 11 labels are now qualified with {CUBE}, and gen-reference-domains.mjs is fixed so regeneration cannot reintroduce it.

The total also confirms the domain joins lose no rows: 47,237 equals a plain Orderfacts.linecount over the same window, so every order line finds both its delivery rule and its invoice rule.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id WHERE o.ad_client_id=1000026 AND o.processed='Y' AND o.isproposal='N' AND o.dateordered >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.dateordered < DATE '2026-04-01'
